exceptions.reason: Run() is the E2E entry point requiring a live Python runtime and real git operations. The DryRun path and all pure helper functions are covered. The 85% coverage target (docs/compliance-checklist.md) is architecturally infeasible without an integration test harness that bootstraps a Python venv.
BootstrapVenv() and LaunchPython() require a real Python binary and venv; these are covered by integration tests only. BootstrapToken, Kill, and message helpers are unit-tested.
RunYieldTUI() requires an interactive terminal (bubbletea Program.Run). View() and Update() state machine are unit-tested. The terminal-bound path is covered by manual QA.
cobra command RunE functions are integration-boundary code; most paths require a fully initialized workspace. Core logic is delegated to internal packages which are unit-tested.
